name: deep_sea_2
note: 水世界 / 深海峽谷2 (Water World, Deep Sea Canyon 2). Swimming map: direct dot sensing, no scroll-pin. minimap crop measured from video (dot spans full-frame x~47-185, y~247-543); TUNE h if lower platforms clip. nodes/farm_nodes are placeholders -- regenerate from a recording (see docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-25-water-map-workflow.md). detector 'fish' template-matches bombing_fish_house/goby/bone_fish; TUNE fish_scale/fish_threshold/count_roi with `python recovery.py fishcount --map maps/deep_sea_2.json`, or set detector 'time' for pure timed rotation.
swim_note: tol_y_down (BELOW target) kept tight so she always seats ABOVE the platform (lower y = higher). With lift 5, band bottom = platform_y-5+3 = platform_y-2, so arrival is ~2px above the platform, never below it. tol_y_up (ABOVE) is generous (she sinks onto it); P4 overrides it tighter for the P3 stack. Measured platform y: P6~214, P5~171, P3=P4=136, P2~105, P1~87.
fall_note: farming re-seats if >12px below the node (< the 17px P1-P2 gap, so she can't drift onto the platform below and keep 'farming' the node above). tol_y_down=3 keeps arrival from seating low. debounced by fall_confirm=2.
shared_detect_note: ONE yolo_detect per approach beat gives both mobs + the player box (pushed to the anchor), instead of a separate mob pass + anchor pass -- ~halves hot-loop YOLO cost. Only applies with detector=mob_yolo + anchor=yolo_player. Set false to revert to the two-pass path.
mob_imgsz_note: YOLO inference size -- the main latency driver. 640 is the original low-latency value; was bumped to 960 for small-goby recall but that ~doubled per-pass cost and felt too slow. Back to 640 (with shared_detect on, one 640 pass/beat). Raise toward 768/960 if goby recall suffers; that's the speed<->recall knob.
continuous_note: HOLD the attack key while in range (skill repeats on hold) and only release on a move/deplete/fell -- keeps her attacking through re-detects instead of the choppy burst gaps. attack_dwell_secs = pause between re-decisions while held.
priority_lock_grace_note: in-range beats to keep firing a locked fishhouse's last spot before giving it up. Tried 5 to curb P6 fishhouse-hopping; it did NOT stop the hopping (the lock still flips to the px-nearest fishhouse -- a lock-stability bug, not grace) and it lengthened firing-into-empty after a kill. Reverted to 2 pending the lock-stability fix (debug_log now traces pri_lock_pos RESET and player-found per beat).
priority_note: priority_class=null DISABLES fishhouse-first targeting -> she targets the nearest same-platform mob (original behavior); the lock, occlusion-hold and post-kill hold are all gated on priority_class so they're off too. Set priority_class='fishhouse' to re-enable (then priority_hold_hits / priority_lock_grace / priority_range apply).
attack_range_note: fire in place within this px; beyond it she WALKS closer. 250 fired from a bit too far; 200 closes in more before firing (better kills / less firing at distance). Lower further if she still shoots from too far; raise back toward 250 if she over-walks / steps into mobs.
approach_ease_note: 0 = disable the tap-and-stop ease-in (it caused small stepping near a mob). With the wide attack_range 190 there's no tight target to overshoot, so walk continuously straight into range. Raise it only if a tighter range is reintroduced and she coasts past.
node_same_platform_band_note: per-node override of same_platform_band. P1=85: on P1 she sometimes stands HIGHER than the fishhouse, so its feet read ~60-76px below hers (vs ~7 elsewhere); the global 75 skipped those (measured: a real 60-76 cluster on P1). 85 keeps P1's own mobs through that, and still sits ~at the P2 gap (~81) -- any occasional P2 leak is harmless now (node_bounds edge-guard + distance-gate stop her walking off / chasing it). Other nodes stay at the global 75.
same_platform_band_note: screen-px |mob_feet - player_feet| to count a mob as on THIS platform. Must thread two failure modes: below ~81 (the P1<->P2 screen gap -- 85 leaked, she locked a P2 fishhouse 81px below her while on P1) and ABOVE ~70 (while she's still SINKING onto a node the HP-bar anchor reads her feet ~90px high, so P1's own fishhouse looks ~69-70px away -- 60 rejected it and she depleted+skipped P1 during the ~0.7s settle; once seated the delta is ~9px). 75 sits between: >70 keeps P1's mob through the settle, <81 still rejects the P2 cross-platform mob. VERIFY LIVE -- raise toward 80 if P1 still skips during settle; lower toward 70 if a P2 mob leaks onto P1. Root cause is the settle-transient foot read; a post-arrival settle delay before counting depletion is the more robust fix if the band can't cover both.
anchor_settle_max_note: cap on the anchor-settle wait -- the arrival latency the player feels (she waits this long before locking/detecting on a crowded platform, where the anchor never settles). Lowered 2.0->1.0 to cut that lag. A clean arrival SINK isn't fully settled in 1s so she may lock a touch early, but the deplete-freeze during the wait still prevents the skip. Lower further (toward 0.5) for even less arrival lag at the cost of occasionally locking before grounded; raise back toward 2.0 if arrival wrong-locks/skips (P2-left, P1/P6) return.
anchor_settle_note: while NO lock is held, wait until the last 3 player feet-y reads span <= this before targeting -- the anchor is mid-settle (arrival SINK, e.g. 472->497->671->...->715) or knocked, and its feet read is unreliable, which flips same-platform membership (real mob drops out, a mob on the platform above/below reads in-band). She'd otherwise lock the wrong one and fire it IN THE AIR mid-sink (P2 'hits left'), and the empty reads skip the platform (P1/P6). 20: a settled stand spans ~2-5px, mid-sink 3-read windows span 25+, so she only locks once grounded (~pfeet 715). A single 2-read/40px check let a mid-sink plateau (472->497) slip through -- hence the 3-read window. Skipped beats also freeze the deplete counter. Raise if she's slow to start after landing; lower if she still fires before grounding. Remove to disable.
conf_gate_note: Distance-gated confidence: a fishhouse FARTHER than low_conf_range(120 screen px) from the player must clear priority_acquire_conf(0.6) or it's ignored; CLOSER ones are kept at the fishhouse_conf(0.3) floor (she's point-blank killing it, VFX dims it). Stops locking/firing at weak far phantoms (the P1 wrong-direction bug: a 0.59 fishhouse 155px away beat the real 0.97 one). Raise low_conf_range or lower priority_acquire_conf if a real far fishhouse gets skipped (real ones read ~0.9+); remove priority_acquire_conf to disable.
sweep_note: farm_nodes are the sweep order BOTTOM->TOP. P3/P4 are stacked and read the same y136; list them consecutively (P3 then P4) -- the bot tracks which by sequence, not by sensing. RIGHT is the rightmost drop waypoint: after the top the bot swims there then down to farm_nodes[0]. Mark all of these during record-route.
node_lift_note: P4=3: P4 and P3 read the same minimap y (~136, stacked). lift 8 (y128) over-rose her onto P3 and skipped P4; lift 0 didn't seat firmly. A small lift (y133) seats on P4 without reaching P3, then the stacked jump handles P4->P3.
node_tol_y_up_note: P4 only: default tol_y_up=16 lets her 'arrive' anywhere across the ~22px stacked band (so the lift often didn't take). 8 tightens the ABOVE band so she must actually rise near the lifted target to seat -- makes the lift consistent. Too tight -> she bobs; raise if she can't seat.
node_arrive_jumps_note: extra straight-up hops right after seating, to firm a landing on a narrow/pin platform. P4=2: P5->P4 she reaches P4's y but doesn't stick (stacked pin below P3) and slides back to P5 in a re-seat loop; 2 hops plant her on P4. Straight up (not the P4->P3 stacked drift), so she lands back on P4. Lower to 1 if she overshoots toward P3; raise if she still falls back to P5.
node_bounds_note: [left_x, right_x] minimap-x walk limits per platform (the approach edge-guard fires here -> she fires in place at the edge instead of walking off). Seeded from routes/deep_sea_2.capture.jsonl (main x-cluster per y-band, 2026-08-31 play). Without these every node used center+-platform_half(60), whose left bound for P2 (center x139) was 79 -- below P3's own x(83) -- so she walked LEFT off P2 chasing a locked off-platform fishhouse and fell to P3 in a loop. P2 left nudged to 123 (edge ~121 +2 for the ~12px/beat walk overshoot); it's the fall-critical one -- raise it if she still drops, lower it if she can't reach P2's left mobs. Others are conservative (where she was seen standing safely); a too-tight bound just makes her fire in place at the edge. VERIFY LIVE that each covers the real platform.
map_box_note: valid dot box [x_min,x_max,y_min,y_max]. y_max=250: platforms live at y<=213 and reads cluster there or at a FIXED bottom phantom (y 301-385) with an empty gap between -- so y_max=250 rejects that phantom, which used to pin fall-recovery at (54,347) and stop her rising. Widen only if a real position ever reads y>250.
player_anchor_max_jump_note: screen px. If the nearest player-box leaps more than this from her last position, it's another player's HP bar (P3 is crowded), not her -- reject it (no lock) so she rides last / stops instead of the anchor drifting box-by-box to the right edge. Big enough for real walking between beats; lower if she still chases, raise if she can't re-lock after moving.
nametag_fallback_disabled_note: PURE HP BAR: nametag/title fallback removed on purpose -- it phantomed onto the nearby player (UwUsagi) during crowded P3/P6 bursts. The YOLO HP-bar class is now the ONLY anchor; a miss rides stale_grace + hold-last-position (she's rooted while attacking, when the bar is buried under damage numbers) and a sustained loss hits the LOST re-seat. To re-enable, restore a nametag_fallback block: {nametag_template, nametag_feet_offset, nametag_accept, title_template, title_feet_offset, title_accept}.
free_market_note: If another player enters and the alarm isn't silenced ('m') within free_market_after_secs, click the 自由市場 (Free Market) button to leave the map. button_xy = its center in the 1942x1136 capture frame; the live click point is the window box + this. Re-grab if the game resolution changes.
collect_miss_frames_note: OFF: don't dump player-miss frames to disk. The retrain (recovered 52% of held-out occlusion misses) is done, so collection is disabled to stop writing ~3MB frames every few seconds. Set true (optionally with yolo_fail_dump_interval, default 3.0s) to gather another batch into datasets/player_yolo_fail/ (+ LOST frames into datasets/player_misses/).
fishhouse_conf_note: per-class detection floor for fishhouses (below mob_conf 0.5 so a fishhouse dimmed by attack VFX isn't lost mid-kill). Raised 0.3->0.45 to drop weak false-positive boxes (the model boxing bone-fish/scenery as a fishhouse ~0.4). Watch that a real fishhouse she's actively killing doesn't drop out under VFX -- if she starts giving up mid-kill, lower back toward 0.35.
